name: Zoom API
description: Provides functionality interacting with the Zoom.us API. This is mainly meant to be a developer module. See the README.
project_description:
Integration with the Zoom Video Conferencing Service .

 Zoom API is a developer focussed module that removes the hassle of figuring out Zoom's authentication requirements for API requests and Webhook implementations.

 Back to top 

 July 2025: Drupal 11 Support 
 
 To use this module on Drupal 11, you'll need a patch for the APITools module. Please let us know if you use the patch so we can get a release out as soon as possible.

 
 Back to top 

 Drupal 7 Version 
 For the moment this module simply provides an easy way to make some of the available API calls. This module does nothing on its own and is only necessary if another module requires it. In June 2023, Zoom is deprecating JWT apps. If you need Server-to-Server Oauth apps support in Drupal 7, we would accept a patch.
